title: PHYSICAL ACTIVITY, AGING, AND CHRONIC DISEASE
description: Addresses the consequences of primary and secondary aging from an individual and public health perspective. Physiological changes associated with aging and chronic disease, functional assessment of older adults, and exercise prescription for older adults with and without chronic exercise will be emphasized.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: KIN 324 and 325.
A minimum grade of C- is required in KIN 324 and KIN 325.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: MW 2pm-3:50pm in WB 205 - Women's Building 205 (GP) (9/23 to 12/4)
